text: So I've been dealing with my brother all evening and honestly I'm shattered. He's 9. Temp's been creeping up and the last reading was 38.2. His left eye has gone all pink and there's sticky yellowish gunk in the corner, it was crusted shut a bit when he woke from a nap earlier and I had to wipe it with warm water. Parents are at a wedding miles away and both phones are going to voicemail so it's on me. Breathing is fine, I actually sat and watched him for a bit because I was being paranoid, totally normal, no wheezing or puffing. He's been to the toilet loads for a wee since tea time so no problem there either, he's had about three cups of squash. I gave him a dose of kids paracetamol at 8 which I checked was ok for his age on the box. Just want to know if the eye thing needs anything doing tonight or if it can be sorted at the pharmacy in the morning, and if the temperature is something to worry about. I've got college in the morning and I'm running on nothing
